subject: Re: Cohosted demo for Apex Systems — APAC time alignment
messages:
From: Kaito Tanaka <kaito.t@apexsystems.jp>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: apexsys-sales@apexsystems.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:10:00 +0900
Subject: Cohosted demo request — APAC availability

Hi Hannah and Vivek,

Thanks again for partnering with Apex Systems on the joint marketplace demo. Our customer in Tokyo is available next week but they prefer an after-hours APAC window (UTC+9) to include local product owners. Do you have a 60–75 minute slot on Tue/Wed/Thu next week between 19:00–22:00 JST?

High level agenda we want to cover:
- 10 min introductions and partnership context
- 35 min live walkthrough (Redwood + Apex integrations)
- 15–25 min Q&A and next steps

Is there any flexibility on your side for a later-start slot? If needed we can split the walkthrough with a 10 minute handoff between Redwood and our SI lead.

I’ve included our sales alias on Cc to coordinate invites.

Thanks,
Kaito Tanaka
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Apex Systems
Kaito T — +81 90 1234 5678

Attachments: apex-context-brief.pdf (1.2 MB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kaito Tanaka <kaito.t@apexsystems.jp>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: apexsys-sales@apexsystems.com, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 10:02:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Cohosted demo request — APAC availability

Hi Kaito—

Thanks for the note and the context. We can support a 70-minute session in the 19:30–21:00 JST window on Tue or Thu. Proposed slots (all JST):
- Tue Mar 28, 19:30–20:40
- Thu Mar 30, 20:00–21:10

If the customer needs an earlier start we can do a 19:00–20:10 slot but that will require a staggered handoff: Redwood runs the first 35 minutes, Apex takes the next 25–30 minutes and we end with a joint Q&A.

I attached a short runbook and the deck we usually present for co-sell demos. Vanessa is on Cc to confirm operational support and whether we should book a dry-run.

Proposed attachments:
- apex-demo-runbook-v1.pdf
- redwood-apex-slide-deck.pptx

Next steps:
1) You confirm preferred slot from the three options above.
2) Vanessa will send a calendar invite + dry-run ask if needed.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Partnerships Manager — Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Kaito and Hannah—quick note from my side. The customer team in Tokyo has a standing product review on Tue at 19:00 JST, so Tue 19:30 is risky for prep/late starts. I’d recommend Thu Mar 30, 20:00–21:10 JST as the cleanest option: it avoids overlap and gives us a full 70-minute contiguous window.

If Thu is not possible, we can do Wed with a strict handoff: Redwood covers the first 35 minutes and Apex leads the second half. Vanessa, can the ops team support a dry-run on Wed Mar 29 at 11:00 JST? That will help with transitions and the demo breakpoint.

-Vivek
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Hi all—

Per Vivek’s recommendation we’ll lock Thu Mar 30, 20:00–21:10 JST. I’ve created the invite and added a 30-minute dry-run on Wed Mar 29 at 11:00 JST for both teams. Calendar link is below.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=apex-cohost-demo-20280322
Dry-run: Wed Mar 29, 11:00–11:30 JST

I’ve attached the runbook we’ll use during the dry-run. Please review section 3 (handoff script) and flag any requested edits by EOD Mon Mar 27.

Cheers,
